[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided five primary benefits of learning music theory:  
[ASSISTANT] 1. Better understanding of musical structure.  
[ASSISTANT] 2. Improved technical skills.  
[ASSISTANT] 3. Greater musical communication.  
[ASSISTANT] 4. Ability to analyze and learn new music quickly.  
[ASSISTANT] 5. Greater confidence in musical abilities.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant recommended the following resources for learning music theory:  
[ASSISTANT] 1. MusicTheory.net - free lessons and exercises on music theory.  
[ASSISTANT] 2. Online courses on platforms like Udemy and Coursera taught by professional musicians and educators.  
[ASSISTANT] 3. YouTube channels, specifically mentioning Rick Beato and Adam Neely.  
[ASSISTANT] 4. Books, including "Music Theory For Dummies" by Michael Pilhofer and "The Jazz Theory Book" by Mark Levine.  
[ASSISTANT] 5. Private lessons from a music teacher for personalized instruction.  
[EVENT] User plans to start learning music theory with MusicTheory.net and check out some YouTube channels.
